description: No-code business automation tool like Zapier or Tray. For example, you can send a Slack notification for each new Trello card.

promotion.reason: Withheld on 2026-09-10 although it qualified. The only importable definition is CapRover's, which pins 0.12.2 built 2023-11-01; upstream released 0.90.4 on 2026-09-08, seventy-eight minor versions later. Revisit when a definition tracks a current release.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Runs automations that call other services with credentials you give it, and stores those credentials in its own database.
